implementation: Commitment helpers share exact field encodings and ordered validation while accepting an explicit fallible hash callback; public CPU APIs retain signatures and reference hashing
Proving-only scoped derivations select the registered GPU witness backend, admit policy and worker resources before any hash, and release their public device session before private proving
Untyped, grouped-pair, typed, paired and finalizer proving construct statement roots and validate canonical empty roots with the selected backend, including the private prove guards
CPU wallet/child verification and host expected-statement helpers remain explicit CPU paths; proving contexts reuse the authenticated session profile pin
PublicValues observations record actual completed GPU batches and event time; capability inventory remains mixed because compiler registry fingerprints still use CPU arithmetic
Existing witness reservations already include the fixed 32800-byte public hash scratch; no new environment switch or remote device handles are introduced
limitations: Integration proofs are bounded recursive empty proofs at height 2048, not full-size wrapped-wallet, merged, finalized or mixed-transaction root proofs
Root conformance covers all transaction kinds, ordered dense prefixes, padding, context binding, metadata rejection and finalizer derivation; this is not a full transaction-throughput measurement
Compiler registry hashing, individual remaining stage observations and strict GPU admission are unfinished
Wallet/batch and C-ABI proving arithmetic, unsupported legacy/profile arithmetic, AMD/Metal qualification, full-size memory, cancellation/retry and sustained pool throughput remain open
